info.title: PayTest Gateway API
info.description: Simulated payment gateway for the PayTest mobile assessment. This is a sandbox: no real payment processing happens, but the API behaves like a real gateway — transport success (HTTP status) and business outcome (transaction status) are two different things, and you should design your client accordingly. Not every failure mode a client might encounter is enumerated below; build defensively.

post.description: Creates a user and an initial session in one call — you get a token back immediately, no separate login required after signing up.

409.description: An account with this email already exists

401.description: Email or password is incorrect (the same error is returned for both cases, deliberately — don't leak which one it was)

post.summary: Log out (revoke the current session only)

delete.description: Deletes the user, revokes every session for that user, and removes their transactions. Irreversible.

post.description: Card number and CVV are only ever used to derive a token and safe metadata; they are never persisted or echoed back. Cards are a shared pool visible to every logged-in user, not scoped per-account.

422.description: The submitted expiration date is already in the past

get.summary: Retrieve a single card by token

post.description:
Returns 200 for every outcome that reaches the business-processing stage — including declines. **A 200 response does not mean the payment was approved; check the `status` field.** Some requests take several seconds to resolve; your client should stay responsive and prevent duplicate submissions while waiting.

Supports an optional `Idempotency-Key` header. If you send the same key again, the original transaction is returned unchanged instead of creating a duplicate — use one key per user-initiated attempt, and reuse it (don't regenerate) on retries of that same attempt. The key is scoped to your account, not global.

The created transaction is owned by whoever is authenticated — there is no way to create a transaction on another account's behalf.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-generated unique key for this authorization attempt.

200.description: Business-processing stage reached. Inspect `status` — AUTHORIZED, DECLINED, and PENDING are all valid outcomes here.

422.description: The card could not be charged (e.g. inactive or expired), or the gateway rejected the request before reaching the business-processing stage. Not persisted as a transaction. Other 4xx/5xx outcomes are possible — this API does not guarantee only the codes listed here.

get.description: Returns only the authenticated account's own transactions — not a global list.

get.summary: Retrieve a single transaction by id
get.description: Returns 404 both when the id doesn't exist and when it belongs to a different account — the two cases are not distinguished.

404.description: No transaction found for the given id

bearerAuth.description: The token returned by /auth/signup or /auth/login. Send it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Every endpoint except /health, /auth/signup, and /auth/login requires it.

ValidationError.description: Request body is missing or has invalid fields

CardNotFound.description: No card exists for the given token

Unauthorized.description: Missing, invalid, or revoked session token

token.description: Opaque session token. Store it; there is no way to recover it later.
